name: c-cascader-1
title: Nested attribute picker with drill-down navigation.
label: Attribute Picker
description: Nested attribute picker with drill-down navigation.

guidance.bestFor: Person, company and workspace fields with a type icon per row, counts on branches and a trigger path capped at 3 segments
agentNotes: Each branch `count` in `attributes` is a hardcoded number that overrides the real child total; drop it to show how many children a branch has

whenNotToUse.when: Several attributes picked at once, each row with a checkbox

name: c-cascader-2
title: Multi-select permissions with checkboxes and a selection cap.
label: Multi-Select Cap
description: Multi-select permissions with checkboxes and a selection cap.

guidance.bestFor: Product area permissions like billing and deployments, capped at 5, with one disabled row and a clear X over the trigger and in the footer
agentNotes: The clear X is a sibling of `CascaderTrigger`, positioned over it, because the trigger is a button; never move it inside the trigger

whenNotToUse.when: A whole area with all of its permissions taken in one press

name: c-cascader-3
title: Deep search across every level with path-annotated results.
label: Deep Search
description: Deep search across every level with path-annotated results.

guidance.bestFor: A source file tree whose search reaches files below the open folder, with folder paths telling repeated names like page.tsx apart

whenNotToUse.when: Search that covers the whole tree while a nested level is open

name: c-cascader-4
title: Pinned footer with a side-anchored import flyout.
label: Footer Flyout
description: Pinned footer with a side-anchored import flyout.

guidance.bestFor: A property picker whose footer opens a flyout of 7 app and data source logos in 2 named groups
agentNotes: `onImport` only writes an Importing from line into `log`; start your real import from there
`ImportSourceMenu` calls `close` from `useCascaderSubmenu` after each run, which is what dismisses the flyout

name: c-cascader-5
title: Custom rows with avatars and role badges.
label: Avatar Rows
description: Custom rows pairing avatars with outline role badges that color-code seniority.

guidance.bestFor: An assignee picker by team, each member row with a photo, an online or away dot and a seniority chip, and the face repeated in the trigger
agentNotes: Each member `avatar` in `teams` is an Unsplash photo URL; point it at your own user images
`membersByValue` indexes only the direct children of each team, so a member nested deeper shows no avatar in the trigger

name: c-cascader-6
title: Trigger path formatting and collapsing.
label: Path Formatting
description: Trigger path formatting and collapsing.

guidance.bestFor: A connected app tree with a toggle that switches the trigger between collapsed, full, tail, leaf and a custom 2 line readout
agentNotes: Keep 1 `CascaderValue` setup and drop the `ToggleGroup` and `format` state, which exist only to compare trigger formats

name: c-cascader-7
title: Embedded panel without a popover.
label: Embedded Panel
description: Embedded panel without a popover.

guidance.bestFor: A docs table of contents searched and drilled right on the page inside a Card, with the list height capped at 240px
agentNotes: Picking a page only stores it in `value`; navigate to it from `onValueChange` yourself
Keep `maxHeight` on `CascaderList`: with `inline` there is no positioner, so the cap is the only bound on the panel

whenNotToUse.when: A picker that opens from a button and floats over the page

name: c-cascader-8
title: Flat adjacency data with a parent pointer.
label: Flat Data
description: Flat adjacency data with a parent pointer.

guidance.bestFor: Region and department rows as a database returns them, unsorted with a parent id each, plus a footer command that resets the pick
agentNotes: Feed your query result into `rows`; `getParent` reads `parentId`, and a row whose parent is missing becomes a root

name: c-cascader-9
title: Controlled path, value, query and open state.
label: Controlled State
description: External buttons jump the panel to a level, reset it to the root and clear the selection, with all four controlled props printed under the control.

guidance.bestFor: A restaurant menu where outside code drives the open level and search text, and each commit reports its reason and full path
agentNotes: Writing `value` from outside never fires `onValueChange`, so the Clear selection button sets `lastChange` by hand
`goTo` also sets `open`, because a `path` written while the popup is closed renders nothing

name: c-cascader-10
title: Translated labels across a country picker.
label: Translated Labels
description: A German country picker where every string the primitive renders comes from labels, including the live-region announcements, with each flag in an IconTile.

guidance.bestFor: Data and chrome both in German, down to plural forms like 1 Land and 2 Länder and the arrow key hint read to screen readers
agentNotes: Keys left out of `labels`, such as paging, errors and chips, fall back to English; translate them before shipping
The trigger `aria-label` and the `CascaderValue` placeholder sit outside `labels`, so translate them as well

name: c-cascader-11
title: Two-line rows with descriptions and a disabled option.
label: Two-Line Rows
description: Two-line rows with descriptions and a disabled option.

guidance.bestFor: Data center locations from country to city, each row a tile plus a second line of counts or region codes, with China locked

name: c-cascader-12
title: Form field that submits like a native input.
label: Native Form Field
description: Form field that submits like a native input.

guidance.bestFor: An uncontrolled support topic field in a labelled form, its popup matched to the trigger width and its pick read back from FormData
agentNotes: `onSubmit` calls `preventDefault` and only echoes `topic` into `submitted`; post the form data to your endpoint there

whenNotToUse.when: A saved field that reopens on its own level and searches the whole catalog

name: c-cascader-13
title: Columns mode with independently scrolling panels.
label: Columns Mode
description: A media library in Miller columns where all three panes overflow and each scrolls on its own.

guidance.bestFor: Video, audio and article items grouped by library and collection, with a hued tile per library and a runtime chip on items and the trigger
agentNotes: Keep `w-auto` and `min-w-0` on `CascaderContent`, or the trigger width floors the popup and the columns cannot size it

whenNotToUse.when: A hierarchy whose rows expand in place under each parent

name: c-cascader-14
title: Tree mode with inline expand and multi-select scopes.
label: Tree Mode
description: Tree mode with inline expand and multi-select scopes.

guidance.bestFor: A move to destination picker whose root level splits into Recently used and All spaces, reordering each time a folder is picked
agentNotes: `DestinationItems` slices `renderedItems`, so the first `recentCount` root rows must be the recent spaces, as `items` builds them
Leave `index` off each hand composed `CascaderItem`; outside a windowed list it breaks the highlight and `aria-activedescendant`
`handleValueChange` reorders `recent` and logs a Moved to line but moves nothing; call your move API there

whenNotToUse.when: A hierarchy that expands in place with a checkbox on every row

name: c-cascader-15
title: Async drill-down that loads before it navigates.
label: Async Loading
description: Async drill-down that loads before it navigates.

guidance.bestFor: Repositories, releases and paged release assets fetched on demand, with a toned badge per row and a button that fails the next request
agentNotes: Replace `getChildren`, which fakes a 700ms backend from `REPOSITORIES`, with your fetch and pass it `context.signal`
Set `hasChildren` on every branch you have not fetched yet, or it renders as a selectable leaf
Drop `failNext` and its button; they exist only to show the retry row

name: c-cascader-16
title: Virtualized level with thousands of rows.
label: Virtualized List
description: Six unevenly sized regions of country markets, windowed so only the visible rows ever mount.

guidance.bestFor: Nearly 3,000 generated sales markets with flags, a territory name and a reach badge toned by subscriber tier
agentNotes: `buildDirectory` generates the markets in `requestAnimationFrame` after mount; load your own data into `items` instead
Keep `maxHeight` on `CascaderList`, since a windowed list needs a fixed scrollport to divide into rows
Start with an empty `value`: a deep preselection makes `revealSelected` mount the popup on the level holding it, measured at 865ms for 2,500 rows

name: c-cascader-17
title: Consumer-rendered removable chips with path-aware labels.
label: Removable Chips
description: Chips rendered outside the primitive from useCascaderSelection, each carrying its full path so repeated column names stay distinct.

guidance.bestFor: A report builder that adds table columns several at a time, counting them in the trigger and listing each as a removable chip below
agentNotes: `ColumnChips` reads `useCascaderSelection`, so it has to render inside `Cascader`

whenNotToUse.when: Toggling which fields an existing table displays, in place

name: c-cascader-18
title: Cascading tree multi-select inside a popover.
label: Tree Multi-Select
description: A cascading tree with indeterminate branches in a popover, bounded by the positioner's available height.

guidance.bestFor: Shipping zones by continent, region and country, where 1 press takes a whole region and the trigger names top picks plus a country total
agentNotes: Under `cascade`, ticking a region puts the region and every country in `value`; filter to leaves as `ZoneValue` does before saving
Leave `maxHeight` off `CascaderList` here; the popover bounds the growing tree by the viewport height left below the trigger

whenNotToUse.when: Permissions picked one by one under a cap, with no parent and child linking

name: c-cascader-19
title: Status and priority colour dots via renderLabel.
label: Color Dots
description: Status and priority colour dots via renderLabel.

guidance.bestFor: Workflow fields such as status, priority, severity and effort, each value marked by a colored dot that the trigger repeats beside its group
agentNotes: Each `dot` in `workflow` is a literal class pair; a class assembled at runtime compiles to nothing

name: c-cascader-20
title: Expense accounts with a colour inherited down each branch.
label: Inherited Colors
description: Expense accounts with a colour inherited down each branch.

guidance.bestFor: A chart of accounts where any level can be booked, each row with its ledger code and spend, and the picked tile filled in place of a check
agentNotes: `accountOf` reads the hue from the first dotted segment of `value`, so prefix every value with its top level account key
Wrap each top level node in `account`, which stamps its tile on the whole subtree

name: c-cascader-21
title: Global search across the whole tree from a nested level.
label: Global Search
description: A product category field that reopens on its current level, where typing still searches the whole catalog and each hit shows the trail it lives under.

guidance.bestFor: A labelled store taxonomy preset to Headphones, with 2 Chargers rows under different branches told apart by their trail

whenNotToUse.when: Search that stays inside the open level and the levels below it
